context.issue_title: ISS-0206: store.zig rowToDefinition leaks on allocation failure — 4 sequential dupes, zero errdefer guards

task.description:
WF-03 Step 2 (SOLUTION DESIGN): Produce the fix design artefact for ISS-0206.

## Background (from Step 1 diagnosis)

ISS-0206: src/definition/store.zig rowToDefinition (store.zig:1437-1502) performs 5 sequential fallible allocations (4 dupes for name/version/description/stage plus 1 parseGraphJson call) with ZERO errdefer guards. Any mid-sequence allocation failure leaks the dupes that already succeeded. Identical defect class to PGJ-2/PGJ-3 fixed in parseGraphJson under ISS-0132 / GH #427 (proven fix at store.zig:1318-1421). It was not fixed in the ISS-0132 run because rowToDefinition consumes row: []?[]u8 (a pg.zig result row), so std.testing.checkAllAllocationFailures cannot drive it without a live DB row or a row-shaped fixture — out of the ISS-0132 run's reach.

The diagnosis recommends extracting a fixture-driven rowToDefinitionFromFields(allocator, *const RowFields, fallback) signature so checkAllAllocationFailures can drive it. The DB-row variant becomes a thin wrapper.

## Design Output

Produce a Type E prose design artefact at `src/design/iss0206-rowtodefinition-errdefer.md` per `docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md §6`. The design MUST include:

1. **Problem statement** — restate the partial-construction leak in plain language. Cite the 5 fallible sites and line numbers (1451, 1452, 1457, 1471, 1481).
2. **Root cause** — cite store.zig:1437-1502 and explain that the struct literal at the end is the only owner of every dupe, with no errdefer to release on the error path.
3. **Proven pattern** — point at store.zig:1318-1421 (parseGraphJson, fixed under ISS-0132 / GH #427) as the same-class pattern in the same file. Quote the PGJ-2/PGJ-3 'local + errdefer before next fallible' convention.
4. **Fix strategy**:
   - **rowToDefinition** (existing signature) becomes a thin wrapper that extracts column strings via the existing col.get/col.getOpt helpers (kept unchanged) and delegates to rowToDefinitionFromFields.
   - **rowToDefinitionFromFields** (new internal signature) does the actual fallible mapping. Body sketch MUST register each errdefer immediately after the corresponding try; the struct literal is built LAST.
   - **RowFields** (new private struct) mirrors the 11 columns as plain []const u8 / ?[]const u8 slices — no nested allocations, no []?[]u8 of unknown lifetime. This is what makes checkAllAllocationFailures able to drive it directly.
   - **graph errdefer** runs graph.deinit(allocator) regardless of whether the graph came from parseGraphJson (allocating) or the empty-JSON branch (fallback.graph, a no-op deinit).
5. **No caller signature changes** — list all 9 existing call sites (store.zig lines 294, 347, 688, 775, 862, 1067, 1205, 1511, 1542) and state that NONE are to be modified.
6. **No new error variants** — error{OutOfMemory}!Definition is preserved. Most call sites keep their `catch` into DefinitionError.TransactionFailed.
7. **Test plan** — tests/unit/iss0206_rowtodefinition_errdefer_test.zig drives rowToDefinitionFromFields (NOT rowToDefinition) via std.testing.checkAllAllocationFailures. Two required test cases (TC-ISS-0206-01 with all fields populated, TC-ISS-0206-02 with optional fields absent). Document TC-ISS-0206-03 as a comment-level regression: the unfixed function fails the harness; the fix makes it pass.
8. **Build wiring** — the new test file is wired into build.zig as a new addTest target, attached to zig build test (the aggregate step), NOT only to a narrow step. This is the exact defect (ISS-0150 / GH #466) that tools/lint_test_wiring.py guards, and the same inert-test class ISS-0132 / GH #427 exists to end.
9. **Acceptance criteria** — restate the GitHub issue acceptance: rowToDefinitionFromFields guards every dupe + the graph with errdefer; the new test fails against the unfixed body and passes after the fix; zig build test exits 0 with no DebugAllocator leak output; no caller signature changes; no mocks/stubs.

## Important: Do Not Implement

You are the CODE-DESIGNER. Do NOT modify any test, source, or migration file. Write ONLY the design artefact src/design/iss0206-rowtodefinition-errdefer.md. BACKEND-DEV will implement per the design.

## Validation

Before completing the handoff, run:
```bash
python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss0206-rowtodefinition-errdefer.md
```
Expected: exit 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR.
acceptance_criteria: Design artefact src/design/iss0206-rowtodefinition-errdefer.md exists and is well-formed Markdown
Design explicitly classifies as Type E (per templates/lego-catalog.md) and cross-references ISS-0132 / GH #427 parseGraphJson pattern at store.zig:1318-1421
Design covers all 5 fallible sites (name, version, description, parseGraphJson, stage) with concrete line numbers and per-site errdefer placement
Design introduces the new rowToDefinitionFromFields(allocator, *const RowFields, fallback) signature and the new private RowFields struct so checkAllAllocationFailures can drive the function
Design explicitly excludes changing any of the 9 caller signatures (store.zig lines 294, 347, 688, 775, 862, 1067, 1205, 1511, 1542)
Design lists Error taxonomy section that confirms NO new error variants (error{OutOfMemory}!Definition preserved)

Design specifies the new unit test file tests/unit/iss0206_rowtodefinition_errdefer_test.zig with TC-ISS-0206-01/02/03 cases and mandates attaching the new test target to zig build test (not a narrow step)
python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss0206-rowtodefinition-errdefer.md exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR
Inner report file at docs/issue-reports/WF03-GH526-20260807-step-2-code-designer-INNER-REPORT.json exists in JSON
Handoff result filled with PASS, summary, artifacts_out, completed_at

result.summary: Step 2 PASS: produced src/design/iss0206-rowtodefinition-errdefer.md (Type E). The design specifies: (1) a new private RowFields struct that mirrors the 11 DB columns as plain []const u8 slices so checkAllAllocationFailures can drive the function; (2) a new internal signature rowToDefinitionFromFields(allocator, *const RowFields, fallback) error{OutOfMemory}!Definition whose body follows the proven parseGraphJson errdefer pattern at store.zig:1318-1421 — each fallible dupe lands in a local guarded by its own errdefer BEFORE the next fallible statement runs, and the Definition struct literal is assembled LAST; (3) graph.deinit(allocator) errdefer handles the parseGraphJson result regardless of which branch populated it; (4) the existing rowToDefinition becomes a thin wrapper that fills a RowFields via the existing col.get/col.getOpt helpers and delegates — no caller signature changes, no new error variants, all 9 call sites unchanged; (5) tests/unit/iss0206_rowtodefinition_errdefer_test.zig with TC-ISS-0206-01 (all fields populated), TC-ISS-0206-02 (optional fields absent) and TC-ISS-0206-03 (regression negative control), wired into zig build test (not a narrow step) per the ISS-0150 / GH #466 lesson. Lint: BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=0 MINOR=2 (the 2 MINOR are linter over-matching the words 'id' and 'format' inside non-requirement-id prose; non-blocking per lint exit-code policy). No implementation code touched; design-only.
